02:00–03:05 · 65 sec · TV broadcast

Chief Barkington Orders appears, declaring a national salmon emergency affecting Districts 7–12. The corporate broadcast advises cats to secure a month's worth of fresh salmon immediately.

Shots: CRT news graphic → Barkington medium shot → salmon shortage map → extreme close-up of his smug expression → crew reaction inserts.

scenes.title: Salmon for Everyone
scenes.staging:
Scene 23 — Salmon for Everyone

19:05–19:30 · 25 sec · District 7 market

The first redirected salmon shipments arrive. Cats cheer as vendors reopen their stalls. NIP7 reports that the distribution records confirm preferential treatment for wealthy dog districts.

Shots: Truck arrival → salmon crates → cheering citizens → NIP7 news broadcast → crew watching from a rooftop.

lines.speaker: NIP7 Anchor
lines.text: Newly released records confirm that Goodboy Global diverted salmon shipments away from feline neighborhoods.

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: We saved the fucking city!

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: We saved dinner.

lines.speaker: Ghost
lines.text: For now.

scenes.title: Back to the Game
scenes.staging:
Scene 24 — Back to the Game

19:30–20:00 · 30 sec · Resistance hideout

The crew returns home, collapses onto the couch, and turns on CatStation 5. Grand Theft Kitty VI resumes at the Great Dog National Bank heist.

Shots: Wide hideout → controllers being picked up → TV loading screen → Trixie's face → group couch wide → final TV close-up.

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: All right. Now it's time to finish this mission.

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: We've been trying to finish this shit all day.

lines.speaker: Neon
lines.text: At least nobody can interrupt us now.

lines.speaker: TV
lines.text: Goodboy Global HAS AN IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT—

lines.speaker: Onyx
lines.text: OH, FUCK OFF!
